enableDialog.title: Enable AI Feature Notice
enableDialog.line1: Enabling AI features means you accept potentially unstable Agent behavior. After enabling, please restart the core — the system will load dependencies using **approximately 200MB of memory**. After restart, continue with configuration; you must also **configure a persona** before using AI features.
enableDialog.line2: To save token consumption, do not extend the persona scope to all group chats.
enableDialog.line3: **Passive Perception** in **Memory Settings** will consume a large number of tokens, as all messages are analyzed in the background to generate a memory graph.
enableDialog.line4: You must configure a **web search service** for the Agent to retrieve the latest information.
enableDialog.line5: The blacklist/whitelist in **Advanced Settings** takes effect globally and takes priority over persona configuration.
enableDialog.line6: To view this notice again, click the **Usage Help** button in the top right corner.
enableDialog.line7: It is recommended to use a **remote Qdrant service** for better performance and stability. You can download Qdrant from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant/releases) and run it directly, or use the [Qdrant Cloud](https://cloud.qdrant.io/) hosted service.

disableDialog.title: Disable AI Feature Notice
disableDialog.line1: To fully release AI feature resource usage, it is recommended to restart the core immediately after disabling.

serviceProvider.title: Service Providers
serviceProvider.subtitle: Service Provider Configuration

requestMethodOptions.responses: Responses (Unified API: tool calls + structured output)

requestMethodDescription.chat_completions: OpenAI's standard /chat/completions endpoint, supported by virtually all chat-compatible providers. Sends a messages array to the model.
requestMethodDescription.responses: OpenAI's newer /responses endpoint that unifies multi-turn tool calls, file references and structured output. Requires the model and proxy to both support it.

remoteWebSearchOptions.off: Off (use local search even on Responses)

remoteWebSearchDescription.off: Always use local Tavily / Jina / Exa. OpenAI Chat Completions never reads this switch.
remoteWebSearchDescription.on: Default. OpenAI Responses or any Anthropic config uses the provider's hosted web_search with no extra setup. OpenAI Chat Completions always uses local search. If a relay does not support hosted tools it will 400 — turn this off then.

forwardEndUserIdDescription.off: Requests carry no caller identity, so upstream only sees usage aggregated for this config as a whole. This is the default.
forwardEndUserIdDescription.hashed: Sends a salted digest of the caller identity in OpenAI's standard user field. Upstream can group usage and logs per caller without ever seeing the original identity.
forwardEndUserIdDescription.raw: Sends the caller identity verbatim in OpenAI's standard user field. Only recommended for trusted upstreams such as your own gateway — never for third-party official endpoints.

serviceProvider.endUserIdSaltPlaceholder: Leave empty for an unkeyed digest
serviceProvider.endUserIdSaltHint: An empty salt means an unkeyed digest: when the identity space is small (numeric account IDs), it can be brute-forced back, so it only obfuscates. Changing the salt orphans every previously sent digest and breaks upstream per-caller history.

serviceProvider.embeddingProviderSwitched: Embedding provider switched to '{provider}', restart required
serviceProvider.openaiEmbeddingBaseUrlDesc: Specify OpenAI-compatible embedding API base URL, usually ends with /v1
serviceProvider.openaiEmbeddingApiKeyDesc: Specify OpenAI-compatible embedding API key, supports multiple keys
serviceProvider.openaiEmbeddingModelDesc: Specify embedding model name for text embedding processing

It is recommended to back up the data/ai_core folder first; a service restart is required after saving, and migration may take a long time.
serviceProvider.primaryProviderDesc: Preferred search provider. With multi-source strategies, failures fall through the fallback list.
serviceProvider.lbStrategyDesc:
**Error switch**: On primary failure, try the next configured fallback in order.

**Auto balance**: Round-robin requests across configured sources.

**None**: Always use the primary source only; no failover.
serviceProvider.fallbackOrderDesc: Multi-select fallbacks; numbers show priority (1 first). Empty = backend uses all configured sources. Primary cannot be a fallback; switching primary strips it from this list.
serviceProvider.primaryConfigSectionDesc: API keys and options for the primary search provider.
serviceProvider.fallbackConfigSectionDesc: API keys and options for fallback providers; used when primary fails.
serviceProvider.fallbackPrimaryStrippedOnSave: Removed primary from fallback list — the primary source cannot also be a fallback.
serviceProvider.configNotAvailable: No editable settings for this provider

**Error switch**: On primary failure, try the next fallback in order.

**Auto balance**: Round-robin requests across candidates.
